annotations.title: Bring links from another link page

description: Copy the links and section titles from another link-in-bio page (Linktree, Beacons, Stan, a personal site) to this one, in that page's order, skipping links already here. Where this bio page has no bio, photo or extra social icons yet, they're filled from that page; nothing already set is replaced. Its background, text and button colors and button shape come over too (colors: false keeps this page's look). With no bio page yet, set one up with bio_page_update using found (found.look.colors fits design.colors). Use dry_run first to show the person what would come over; undo with activity_id takes the links off again, and with page_activity_id puts the page's old look and details back.

colors.description: Copy that page's colors and button shape onto this one

dry_run.description: Say what would be added and skipped, changing nothing

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

on_bio.description: Show them on the bio page

position.description: Where links without a section go: top, bottom (the default), { after: link_id } or { under_section: link_id }

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
